stories.headline: Democrats map out an agenda to address affordability and corruption after midterm sweep
stories.summary: Democrats announced policy priorities focused on affordability and anti-corruption measures following election victories. The agenda signals potential shifts in fiscal and regulatory policy under Democratic leadership.
stories.why_matters: Fiscal policy direction and regulatory environment will influence growth expectations and rate path.

stories.headline: Explainer: How the Democratic sweep could change US energy policy
stories.summary: Democratic electoral wins are expected to reshape US energy policy frameworks. This could affect commodity markets and long-term energy sector valuations.
stories.why_matters: Energy policy changes directly impact oil prices, which hit equities and inflation expectations.

stories.headline: Vance repudiates Iran war after US electoral defeat
stories.summary: VP Vance reversed previous hawkish positions on Iran following Republican electoral setbacks. The shift signals a potential de-escalation in geopolitical tensions tied to Iran policy.
stories.why_matters: Geopolitical de-escalation reduces risk premium in markets and supports lower oil prices and equity valuations.

concept.title: Post-Election Policy Pivot & Risk-Off Easing
concept.one_liner: Democratic sweep reduces geopolitical and policy uncertainty, allowing equity rally and steepening yield curve compression.
concept.explanation: The S&P 500 gained 1.83% while VIX fell 0.32 points, signaling lower tail-risk expectations post-midterms. Democratic agenda focus on affordability and energy policy clarity, combined with geopolitical de-escalation (Vance Iran reversal), has eased uncertainty premia. Meanwhile, the 10Y-2Y curve inverted further (10Y -3 bps to 4.91%, 2Y +3 bps to 4.59%), suggesting markets are pricing in less aggressive future rate hikes and potential cuts ahead.
concept.market_link: Lower geopolitical risk and policy clarity support equities; softer long-end yields reflect growth-recession concerns balanced against Fed easing bias.

narrative: US equities surged 1.83% on post-election clarity and Democratic policy agenda focused on affordability, while volatility declined and yields flattened. Geopolitical de-escalation on Iran and energy policy shifts lower commodity risk, supporting the equity bid even as the yield curve continues to invert.
